dict.string: RedMed writes your emergency card to your NFC bracelet.

RedMed uses Face ID, Touch ID, or your device passcode to protect and unlock editing of your medical profile and to authorize writing to your bracelet. Scanned cards are read-only and cannot be changed without your app and authentication.
RedMed uses your location to give 911 your exact GPS coordinates in an emergency.

Optional Find 911 motion assist uses the accelerometer only while that screen is open to help start a cancelable Emergency SOS countdown after a hard jolt. It is not Apple Crash Detection and does not diagnose seizures.
